kind_of_thing.quote: The cheetah (Acinonyx jubatus) is a species of large feline and the only living member of the genus Acinonyx.

kind_of_animal.quote: A cheetah (Acinonyx jubatus) is a medium large cat which lives in Africa and Asia.

extinct.quote: It is now distributed mainly in small, fragmented populations in northwestern, eastern and southern Africa and central Iran.

pet_farm_or_wild.quote: It lives in a variety of habitats such as savannahs in the Serengeti, arid mountain ranges in the Sahara, and hilly desert terrain.

what_it_eats.quote: It feeds on small- to medium-sized prey, mostly weighing under 40 kg (88 lb), and prefers medium-sized ungulates such as impala, springbok and Thomson's gazelles.
